hypothesis_summary: The `generateConcepts` method in `src/services/gemini.service.ts` has a high cognitive complexity (24) due to a large `switch` statement handling 12 different `GenerationType` cases. By refactoring this method using the Strategy Pattern or a configuration map, we can decouple the request configuration logic from the execution logic, significantly reducing cognitive complexity and improving maintainability.
justification_or_plan: 1. Extract the generation configuration (prompt templates, system instructions, model config) for each `GenerationType` into a separate mapping or factory class. 2. Refactor `generateConcepts` to retrieve the configuration based on the `type`, construct the request dynamically, and then dispatch it. 3. This adheres to OCP (Open/Closed Principle) and removes the massive switch statement.
